command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: write worker script =="
sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/bin
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
OUT="/var/lib/inventory/inventory.log"
while true; do
  printf '%s pid=%s inventory-scan-ok\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$" >> "$OUT"
  sleep 5
done
SCRIPT_EOF
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== STEP 2: write systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker (sandboxed)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=inventory
StateDirectoryMode=0750

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF

echo "== STEP 3: reload + enable + start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "== STEP 4: wait for a couple of write cycles =="
sleep 12

echo "== STEP 5: status =="
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l || true

echo "== STEP 6: confinement checks =="
echo "-- StateDirectory contents --"
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/inventory
echo "-- log contents --"
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log
echo "-- NoNewPrivileges + sandbox props --"
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ReadWritePaths -p DynamicUser -p StateDirectory -p MainPID -p User
echo "-- proc NoNewPrivs bit for running pid --"
MAINPID=$(sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
sudo -n cat /proc/"$MAINPID"/status | grep -i NoNewPrivs
echo "OK"
